Driver confirms delivery with this code

div.div: Drop-off verification code will be generated after pickup is completed.

div.t-attf-class: logspace-timeline-item d-flex align-items-start mb-3 #{item_last and '' or 'pb-3'}

div.t-attf-style: left: 19px; top: 40px; bottom: 0; width: 2px; background-color: #{item['done'] and '#28a745' or '#dee2e6'};

div.t-attf-class: rounded-circle d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center flex-shrink-0 #{item['done'] and (item['current'] and 'bg-primary text-white' or 'bg-success text-white') or 'bg-light text-muted border'}

h6.t-attf-class: mb-0 #{item['current'] and 'text-primary fw-bold' or item['done'] and 'text-success' or 'text-muted'}

h2.button: How do I track my tracking_info?

div.div: Go to "My Orders" and click "Track" on any active tracking_info.
Contact support within 2 hours of booking.

p.t-esc: rating['comments'][:100] + '...' if rating['comments'] and len(rating['comments']) > 100 else rating.get('comments', '')
